# Jacobin

> > A leading voice in democratic socialist politics, featuring analysis of labor movements, economic inequality, and Marxist theory.

Founded by Bhaskar Sunkara, Jacobin publishes long-form political commentary, labor organizing coverage, and socialist critique of contemporary capitalism. Contributors include Peter Frase, Richard Seymour, James Heartfield, and Seth Ackerman, with analysis spanning workers' movements, austerity politics, and left strategy.

## Key Topics

- Democratic socialism
- Labor organizing and workers' movements
- Marxist theory and political economy
- Wealth inequality and class politics
- Austerity and economic policy
- Left political strategy
- Working-class politics
- Socialist magazine publishing
- Labor movement history
- Student and teacher organizing
- Political commentary and analysis
- European labor movements
- Anti-capitalist critique
- Economic rights framework

## About Jacobin

- [Introducing Jacobin](https://jacobin.com/2011/01/introducing-jacobin): Founding statement by Bhaskar Sunkara on magazine's socialist mission
- [Jacobin Homepage](https://jacobin.com/?p=28787): Homepage featuring articles on labor, wealth inequality, and socialism

## Political Analysis & Commentary

- [On the Politics of Abundance](https://jacobin.com/2010/10/on-the-politics-of-abundance): Peter Frase critiques austerity, advocates abundance-based political economy
- [Resenting Hipsters](https://jacobin.com/2011/01/hipsters-food-stamps-and-the-politics-of-resentment): Critiques welfare resentment politics, advocates economic rights framework

## Labor & Organizing Coverage

- [Weekly Sisyphus #1](https://jacobin.com/2010/09/weekly-sisyphus-1): China labor unrest at Honda Foshan and US-China trade relations analysis
- [Weekly Sisyphus #2](https://jacobin.com/2010/09/weekly-sisyphus-2): European austerity protests and ETUC general strike organizing efforts

- [Book-Marx #4](https://jacobin.com/2010/11/book-marx-4): Links on hipster culture, socialist media, and left political commentary
